# ItaRouter — Getting started

ItaRouter provides one API entry point for your applications and AI tools. Create an ItaRouter API key; you do not need to register an upstream provider key or configure channels.

## Current availability

ItaRouter is preparing for launch. Model access and paid top-ups are not available yet. Check the model list and announcements before sending requests. Creating an API key does not add credit to your wallet.

## 1. Create a key

Sign in, open **Console → API Keys**, and create a key for your app. Keep the key on your server; never put it in browser code or a public repository. Configure an expiry and key spending limit when needed. An unlimited key limit still uses your available wallet balance.

## 2. Connect your app

Use the ItaRouter base URL, followed by `/v1` for OpenAI-compatible clients, and your ItaRouter API key. For the public service, the intended base URL is `https://itarouter.com/v1`; local previews use their own local address instead. Only use a model ID listed as available in **Model Square**. Availability depends on the connected service and model.

## 3. Check usage

Use **Wallet** to check balance and **Usage Logs** to review requests and charges. Paid top-ups will open after payment setup and validation. No referral rewards are offered at this stage.

## Source

ItaRouter is based on [New API](https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api). [ItaRouter source and AGPL notices](https://github.com/dodamworks/itarouter).

console_setting.faq.question: Do I need my own provider key?
console_setting.faq.answer: No. Use an ItaRouter-issued API key with your app. Provider channels are managed by ItaRouter.

console_setting.faq.question: Can I call models or add paid credit now?
console_setting.faq.answer: Not yet. The service is preparing for launch. Available models and paid top-ups will be announced after setup and validation.

console_setting.faq.question: Does an unlimited API key mean free or unlimited usage?
console_setting.faq.answer: No. The key limit and wallet balance are separate. API usage still requires sufficient wallet balance. Creating a key does not add credit.

console_setting.faq.question: Are referral rewards available?
console_setting.faq.answer: No referral rewards are offered at this stage.
